item.title: Shreya Sen-Handley | Six Reasons Why 2025 Wasn’t A Total Disaster
item.description: But 2026, by its very name, deserves at least six bequests of hope from 2025, to give it something to build on. The six I will highlight are events that raised a smile in our home, to get you started on lists of your own, because each of us will need uplifting memories to hold on to, on our rocky road to global redemption
